title: helianthemum pilosum var. violaceum
intro: Helianthemum pilosum var. violaceum, commonly known as Purple Rockrose, is a flowering plant species in the family Cistaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties.
